title: Entry Requirements for Zanzibar
excerpt: Zanzibar is part of Tanzania, but it has some extra requirements, such as mandatory travel insurance. What to check before you go.
body:
Zanzibar is part of Tanzania, so your Tanzanian visa is valid there. However, there are some points to check.

## Passport and visa

Your passport usually needs to be valid for at least six months after arrival. See [the Tanzania visa guide](/blog/tanzania-visa-guide/).

## Mandatory insurance

Zanzibar has introduced mandatory inbound travel insurance for foreign visitors, arranged through an official provider. Check the current rules on the official government website before you travel.

## Yellow fever

If you arrive from a country with yellow fever risk (including a long transit in some countries), you may need to show a vaccination certificate. See [vaccinations](/blog/tanzania-vaccinations/).

## Arriving from mainland Tanzania

You pass passport control when arriving by ferry or domestic flight.

## Rules change

Entry rules can change. Always check official sources shortly before departure.

[Plan your trip with us](/travel-proposal/); we will remind you what to check.
